panels.title: Model silence
panels.description: Сколько прошло с последнего удачного вызова модели. Больше трёх часов — бот отвечает отказами, хотя сам жив.

targets.rawSql: select count(*)::int as users from account where access = 'ALLOWED'
select count(*)::int as requests from account where access = 'REQUESTED'
select count(*)::int as meals from meal where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Who used it and when
panels.description: По каждому человеку: когда последний раз звал модель, сколько вызовов вышло и сколько еды попало в дневник за выбранный период.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(nullif(ti.display_name, ''), '@' || ti.username, ti.telegram_id::text) as "User", case a.role when 'ADMIN' then 'admin' else 'user' end as "Role", case a.access when 'ALLOWED' then 'allowed' when 'REQUESTED' then 'requested' when 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' else 'no request' end as "Access", max(u.created_at) as "Last call", count(u.id) filter (where u.kind not like '%\_FAILED')::int as "Calls ok", count(u.id) filter (where u.kind like '%\_FAILED')::int as "Calls failed", (select count(*)::int from meal m where m.account_id = a.id and $__timeFilter(m.created_at)) as "Meals", ti.created_at as "Joined" from account a join telegram_identity ti on ti.account_id = a.id left join usage_record u on u.account_id = a.id and $__timeFilter(u.created_at) group by a.id, a.role, a.access, ti.display_name, ti.username, ti.telegram_id, ti.created_at order by 4 desc nulls last

select $__timeGroup(u.created_at, '1d') as time, coalesce(nullif(ti.display_name, ''), ti.telegram_id::text) as metric, count(*)::int as value from usage_record u join telegram_identity ti on ti.account_id = u.account_id where $__timeFilter(u.created_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: What they did
panels.description: Виды вызовов: распознавание текста и фото, пересчёт по замечанию, подбор обеда.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroup(created_at, '1d') as time, kind as metric, count(*)::int as value from usage_record where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1

select $__timeGroup(m.created_at, '1d') as time, coalesce(nullif(ti.display_name, ''), ti.telegram_id::text) as metric, count(*)::int as value from meal m join telegram_identity ti on ti.account_id = m.account_id where $__timeFilter(m.created_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1

select $__timeGroup(created_at, '1d') as time, coalesce(sum(tokens_in), 0)::int as "in", coalesce(sum(tokens_out), 0)::int as "out" from usage_record where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Model response time
panels.description: Среднее и худшее время вызова за день, в секундах.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroup(created_at, '1d') as time, round(avg(latency_ms) / 1000.0, 1)::float8 as "avg", round(max(latency_ms) / 1000.0, 1)::float8 as "worst" from usage_record where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 1
